final: WITH cc AS (SELECT product_color, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Products GROUP BY product_color), tot AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS s FROM cc), sh AS (SELECT cc.c, cc.c * 1.0 / tot.s AS share FROM cc CROSS JOIN tot WHERE tot.s IS NOT NULL), av AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS a FROM sh), kept AS (SELECT sh.c, sh.share, sh.c - av.a AS excess FROM sh CROSS JOIN av WHERE av.a IS NOT NULL AND sh.c > av.a) SELECT SUM(c) AS total_kept_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept
